push.title: L 3-7 vs Cineplex fc | You: 9.9 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.9, PhogsToffees. That's the sort of game that makes the whole locker room stand a little taller.

THE GOOD
+ Tackle success 67%, up from your usual 24%. Write that one down and stick it on the fridge.
+ 89% passing on 47 attempts, up from your usual 80%. That's composure on the ball.
+ 8 shots at Cineplex fc's goal. You made the keeper earn every dollar tonight.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ Feeding buddskees like that is a recipe I want to keep making.

THE BAD
- 4 of 8 shots on target. Here's a thought: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. Like riding a bike.
- BellyTb1 had the same shot selection trouble. Team up on it: cut it back to each other.
- We shipped 7 goals to Cineplex fc and lost by 4. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.
- 4 tackles won: -0.3. That's your quickest improvement.
- Their humans averaged 9.7 to our 8.3; we were second best man for man. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.

Try this in practice: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Remember, PhogsToffees: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

That's the stuff. Same time next match? - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-7 vs Cineplex fc | You: 7.7
push.body:
A 7.7, BellyTb1. You did your job and then some. That's the kind of teammate folks want.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Cineplex fc's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ 2 key passes. You found gaps I didn't know were there, and I was looking.
+ That partnership with PhogsToffees is starting to feel like a habit.
+ Passes attempted 35, up from your usual 22. That's growth you can count.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (1). You can build a whole match on that.

THE BAD
- 1 of 3 shots on target. Coach's secret: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.7. Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- shot selection got you and PhogsToffees. Communicate and cut it back to each other.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 3. Real quick: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- We shipped 7 goals to Cineplex fc and lost by 4. We win together and we wear this together.

Session plan: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

Hey, BellyTb1. Be a goldfish about mistakes and an elephant about lessons.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-7 vs Cineplex fc | You: 7.3
push.body:
buddskees, a 7.3. I'd rather you have this night now than in a playoff.

THE GOOD
+ 2 shots at Cineplex fc's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 3. I see you, and I like what I see.
+ Better pass accuracy than any of their humans (78% vs their best 76%). Proof you've got another gear.
+ 7 goals conceded: +0.2. That's how good ratings get built.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Mark my words: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Trust the work.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.3. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- You and PhogsToffees share this one: shot selection. Tandem fix: cut it back to each other.
- Passes attempted 9, down from your usual 25. My two cents: Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
- In our wins you average 1 missed tackles; here it was 3. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

Practice prescription: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

buddskees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Rome wasn't built in a day; neither is a great player. - Coach Lasso
